summary: Barings Private Credit Corp filed an 8-K to disclose an amendment to its existing senior secured revolving credit facility with Sumitomo Mitsui Banking Corporation as administrative agent. The amendment increases the total facility from $465 million to $540 million and expands the accordion feature to allow increases up to $750 million. This is a routine credit facility amendment, not a special situation event. No deal terms such as price per share or premium are applicable. The filing does not involve an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special situation. It is a standard financing arrangement update.
